### RetryPolicy

```ts
type RetryPolicy = Readonly<{
  baseMs: number;
  maxMs: number;
}>;
```

Initial and maximum delays for exponential retries.

---

### BackoffDelay

```ts
type BackoffDelay = (attempt, policy) => number;
```

Pure retry-delay port shared by schedule and delivery owners.

Attempt one uses `baseMs`, capped by `maxMs`; zero and negative attempts retain
that same first-delay convention. Later attempts double up to the cap. The owner
supplies its policy; this port reads no clock or durable state.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                          |
| --------- | ----------------------------- |
| `attempt` | `number`                      |
| `policy`  | [`RetryPolicy`](#retrypolicy) |

#### Returns

`number`

## Functions

### nextOccurrence()

```ts
function nextOccurrence(
  cadence,
  after,
): Result<
  number,
  Readonly<{
    kind: "invalid" | "exhausted";
    message: string;
  }>
>;
```

The first occurrence strictly after `after`. Hosts pass the current time after a
firing, so occurrences missed while down or paused coalesce into the next one: a
schedule never replays a backlog.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                  |
| --------- | --------------------- |
| `cadence` | [`Cadence`](#cadence) |
| `after`   | `number`              |

#### Returns

`Result`\<`number`, `Readonly`\<\{ `kind`: `"invalid"` \| `"exhausted"`;
`message`: `string`; \}\>\>

### occurrenceKey()

```ts
function occurrenceKey(schedule): string;
```

The idempotency key of the schedule's current occurrence. A retried or re-fired
admission of the same occurrence carries the same key, so the host's action runs
at most once per occurrence.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                            |
| ---------- | ------------------------------- |
| `schedule` | [`ScheduleCore`](#schedulecore) |

#### Returns

`string`

### afterAdmitted()

```ts
function afterAdmitted<S>(schedule, now): S;
```

### afterRefused()

```ts
function afterRefused<S>(schedule, now, reason, policy?): Refusal<S>;
```

The occurrence was refused. The schedule records why and retries the same
occurrence (same key) after a bounded backoff; one failing schedule never delays
another.
